isobel-a-romance-of-the-northern-trail: James Oliver Curwood — the beloved storyteller of the Canadian wilderness — weaves a romance of the northern trail. His hero follows duty and love through snowbound forests where danger and beauty walk together. Curwood's passion for the wild gives the love story a magnificent setting.
the-lost-trail: Edward S. Ellis — the dime novelist who created Seth Jones — sends his frontiersmen along the lost trail through Indian country. Ambushes, escapes, and woodcraft fill this fast-moving Western adventure. Classic Ellis: clean, exciting, and full of frontier lore for young readers.
the-boy-aviators-in-africa-or-an-aerial-: John Henry Goldfrap's boy aviators fly to Africa on an aerial ivory trail — hunting adventure from above the savanna. Elephants, dangers, and exotic wonders fill this high-spirited tale. Early aviation meets the dark continent in classic boys'-book style.
the-little-regiment-and-other-episodes-o: Stephen Crane — of Red Badge fame — gathers Civil War episodes of searing intensity in this collection. The title story and its companions show war's confusion, courage, and absurdity with pitiless clarity. Crane's impressionistic genius at full power. No one wrote the chaos and pity of battle more vividly than Crane.
among-malay-pirates-a-tale-of-adventure-: Henty's boys fall among Malay pirates — a tale of adventure and peril in Eastern seas. Daring rescues and jungle fights abound. Exotic excitement in the grand manner. Prahus, krises, and tropical isles provide the thrills. Henty's young heroes outwit the pirates in fine style.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-luxe: The Encyclopedia on Luxeuil, Columbanus' wild Vosges foundation. Irish fire met Frankish woods. Richard Urban Butler tells the tale. Strict rule in a stern land. Eustace carried its rule to new houses across Gaul. The laus perennis never ceased in its choir.
